content: We need number of carbonyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no SMILES given. We need to infer from NMR or IR. Carbonyl groups show IR C=O stretch ~1700 cm-1. So we can get IR spectra using tool ir_spectra. That will tell presence of carbonyl peaks. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts ~190-220 ppm. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. Probably cheaper to use IR first. Let's call ir_spectra.
